data.one_liner: A customizable and performant fireworks effect for Flutter powered by the Flame engine.
data.what_it_does: Flutter Fireworks renders vibrant celebratory animations of rockets and exploding fireworks in Flutter apps. It is powered by the Flame game engine and allows full customization of colors, particle counts, and explosion durations.
use_when: You want to add celebratory fireworks animations to your Flutter app
You need a performant particle effect built on top of the Flame engine
avoid_when: You need non-firework complex game mechanics
You want a pure Flutter widget without game engine dependencies
strengths: Smooth animations powered by the Flame game engine
Fully customizable colors, particle counts, and explosion durations
Supports single rocket launches or multiple rocket bursts
weaknesses: Depends on the Flame engine which may be heavy for simple UI-only sparkles
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and use the widget directly in your UI.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to build a full game rather than just a standalone fireworks effect.
